title: Wholesome Winey Moroccan Almonds Khlea
description: A creamy, winey, and nostalgic Moroccan dish that's perfect for a quick snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: wine
ingredients.notes: red wine or a wine-flavored extract

instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the almonds, butter, wine, almond extract, and vanilla extract.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, until the almonds are toasted and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Pour the egg whites into the saucepan and stir to combine.
Return the saucepan to the heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture begins to thicken, about 2 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover the saucepan with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Once chilled, use a slotted spoon to transfer the almond mixture to a bowl of ice water.
Let the mixture sit in the ice water for 10-15 minutes, or until it has firmed up and can be easily shaped into a log.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into a log shape, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Roll the log in powdered sugar, if desired, and serve chilled.
To make the pistachio meal, grind 1/4 cup of pistachios in a food processor until finely ground.
Store any leftover pistachio meal in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week.
